Name: Push and Pull
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
By default this mod lets you push stuff around by simply walking into it, and pull stuff by putting the mouse over it, holding down a key (default [b]Left Ctrl[/b]), and walking away from it.

Supports GMCM with a bunch of config options.
